structure: National C3 Framework (NCSS 2013, rev. 2017), 114 pp. Front matter and Inquiry Arc narrative (pp.1-21) then four Dimensions: D1 Developing Questions (Tables 5-7), D2 Disciplinary Concepts and Tools by discipline (Civics, Economics, Geography, History; Tables 9-23), D3 Evaluating Sources and Using Evidence (Tables 25-26), D4 Communicating Conclusions and Taking Informed Action (Tables 28-30). Each pathway table has a header row 'BY THE END OF GRADE 2 / 5 / 8 / 12' = columns C1..C4 = grade bands K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12; the R2 stem row ('Individually and with others, students...') spans all; indicator cells carry codes D#.#.K-2 / 3-5 / 6-8 / 9-12 (D2 codes include Civ/Eco/Geo/His, e.g. D2.Civ.1.3-5). Cells 'Begins in grades X' are placeholders. Each category has a short narrative paragraph (labeled examples) and a pointer sentence to the table (backup). ELA/Literacy Common Core connection sections after each Dimension are backup. Appendices: A inquiry matrix (examples), B Psychology, C Sociology, D Anthropology, E Scholarly Rationale, Supplement Religious Studies (9-12 indicators D2.Psy/Soc/Rel; anthropology has uncoded bullet outcomes), then References, Glossary, Biographical sketches (backup).
